method: expanding-window pseudo-out-of-sample band evaluation, same origins/seed/draws/paths as coverage_evaluation.json; reduced form, levels in model units. lp_scaling re-estimates the Lenza-Primiceri (2022) Covid innovation scales (2020Q2, Q3, Q4 free, geometric decay after; Pareto(1,1) / Beta(mode 0.8, sd 0.2) hyperpriors, posterior mode) on each origin's training sample and scales the forecast shocks by 1 + (s_T - 1) rho^h
scored_origins_note: 'scored' = the origins #19 (Gaussian k) and #20 (conformal) score: the first 12 + h - 1 origins per horizon are their training burn-in
limitations: Scale parameters at their posterior mode, not integrated out (LP sample them by MCMC); lam/mu/theta fixed at the coverage evaluation's defaults (theta off), as in coverage_evaluation.json.
Consecutive origins share outturn quarters; ~30-49 origins, so 90% coverage has a sampling s.e. of about 0.05.
At origins 2020Q2 and 2020Q3 the forecast decays from the last in-sample scale with rho at its prior mode (0.8), since the later scales and rho are not yet identified.
